description: Supported CSV import/export and daily briefing with deduplication and RBAC protection

verification_details.csv_import_deduplication: Product catalog CSV import deduplicates by SKU: updates existing products when SKU matches; inserts new products when SKU is unseen.
verification_details.csv_exports: Products CSV and Dues CSV export accurately formatted with BDT amounts.
verification_details.rbac_enforcement: Cashier role is strictly forbidden (HTTP 403) from importing or exporting financial catalogs and dues.
verification_details.daily_briefing: Morning executive briefing endpoint provides liquid cash, today sales, low-stock alerts, and 7-day upcoming commitments.
